page.overview:
Who is Caramel Sally?

Caramel Sally is a character heard on a radio in Death's car in the minisode, "The Gift That Reaps Giving". The only song she sings that is heard in the series is "Lonely Bones", though she presumably has other songs. Her style of music is country.

Her skin is light yellow, and her hair is blonde. Her hat is a light shade of yellow, and the top looks similar to the tops of the heads of the Banana Guards. She is seen wearing circular glasses and a white collar with a white heart in the center (the rest of her shirt isn't seen in the drawing).

Spending much of her time living in and eating rocks is what led her to write music, or at least inspired one of her unheard songs (according to an unnamed radio announcer).
